title: Hanging pawns

D0.outcome: Names hanging pawns (a pair side by side with no pawn on adjacent files) and says why they carry both a static weakness and a dynamic strength.

D1.outcome: States the three plans for hanging pawns (hold, advance, liquidate) and when each is right.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled positions, decides to advance when the blockading ring can be attacked, to wait, or to liquidate, and does not choose dead security.

D3.outcome: Predicts the consequence of advancing against an ideal blockader and of liquidating a move too soon.

conditions: Advance into a blockaded position only if the blockading ring can be attacked or the blockaders are unfit.
contrasts: Liquidating a move or two too soon.
